title: Set up Hexmark
lead: A few short steps create the first administrator account.

language.title: Language
language.intro: Choose the language for the setup. It also becomes the default language of this Hexmark installation.

connection.title: Connection check
connection.intro: Hexmark first checks that all parts of the installation can reach each other.

token.title: Setup token
token.intro: Enter the setup token from the server configuration (SETUP_TOKEN in .env). It shows that you control this installation.

account.title: Admin account
account.intro: Create the first account. It becomes the administrator of this Hexmark installation.

detail.serverUnreachable: The web app cannot reach the Hexmark server. Make sure the server is running and that SERVER_INTERNAL_URL points to it.
detail.serverUnexpected: The server sent an unexpected answer (HTTP {status}). Check the server log.
detail.notChecked: Not checked, because the server did not answer.
detail.databaseUnreachable: The server cannot reach the database. Check the POSTGRES_* values in .env and that PostgreSQL is running.
detail.databaseNotMigrated: The database is reachable, but its tables are not set up yet. The server sets them up when it starts; check the server log.
detail.databasePass: The database is reachable and up to date.
detail.tokenPass: A valid setup token is configured on the server.
detail.tokenInvalid: SETUP_TOKEN on the server is set, but not valid. It must be exactly {length} characters, A–Z and 0–9. Set it in .env and restart the server.
detail.tokenMissing: SETUP_TOKEN on the server is not set. It must be exactly {length} characters, A–Z and 0–9. Set it in .env and restart the server.
detail.tokenUnknown: SETUP_TOKEN on the server is missing or not valid. It must be exactly {length} characters, A–Z and 0–9. Set it in .env and restart the server.

connection.fixNote: Fix the failed checks, then check again. You can continue once all checks pass.

token.hint: {length} characters, letters A–Z and digits 0–9. Lower case is fine, and you can paste the whole token.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.hint: How Hexmark greets you. Up to 64 characters.

username.label: Username
username.hint: Shown in logs. 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, ‘_’ and ‘-’. Saved in lower case.

email.label: E-mail address
email.hint: You sign in with this address.

password.label: Password
password.hint: 12 to 128 characters. A long passphrase is easier to remember.

account.blocked: Complete all fields to create the account. Still missing or not valid: {fields}.

invalid_token.title: Setup token not accepted
invalid_token.detail: The token on the server may have changed. Enter the setup token again.

wrong_token.title: Setup token not correct
wrong_token.detail: Compare it with SETUP_TOKEN on the server and try again.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.detail: Setup is paused after several wrong setup tokens. Try again in 15 minutes.

setup_token_not_configured.title: No valid setup token on the server
setup_token_not_configured.detail: SETUP_TOKEN is missing or invalid on the server, so setup cannot finish. Go back to the connection check for details.

database_unavailable.title: Database not available
database_unavailable.detail: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, go back to the connection check.

server_unreachable.title: Server not reachable
server_unreachable.detail: Make sure the Hexmark server is running, then try again.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong on the server
unexpected.detail: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the server log.
